name: review-fixes-log-visibility-green
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
logs=sorted(p.as_posix() for p in Path('maintenance/harness-adoption/evidence').rglob('*.log'))
ignored=[]
for name in logs:
    result=subprocess.run(['git','check-ignore','--quiet','--',name])
    if result.returncode==0: ignored.append(name)
    elif result.returncode!=1: raise RuntimeError('git check-ignore failed: '+name)
visible=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\0'))
missing=sorted(set(logs)-visible)
print({'existing_logs':len(logs),'ignored_logs':len(ignored),'missing_inventory_logs':len(missing),'first_ignored':ignored[:3]},flush=True)
assert logs and not ignored and not missing, 'acceptance logs must be visible to Git inventory'
receipt_projection: log reference rebased into candidate; original exit/status/times/argv/cwd retained; raw receipt hash saved
publication_projection: Actual exit/status/times retained; machine paths replaced with declared logical aliases. log_sha256 binds this public log; private_raw_log_sha256, when present, binds the actual preprojection log. The original raw receipt hash is retained.
